paper_review.purpose: Change test design, variance bookkeeping and urgency; never promote an RLL claim by citation alone.

key_variance_findings.finding: Pantheon+ and DES-Dovekie full-matrix fits exist, but a clean sample/calibration ablation requires identical nuisance and Hubble-flow selection contracts.
RLL best z_t lies outside observed SN support in both current full-matrix fits; null-nested Omega_s0=0 starts exist.
DES-Dovekie CPL best fit has wa=-3.0 exactly on the current lower bound.
Delta-chi2/AIC/BIC are present, but modern Bayesian analyses demonstrate prior-volume/Ockham effects; real logZ and profile likelihood remain required.
DESI DR2 cosmology chains/posterior-maximization products are publicly available; the remaining uncertainty is reproduction and tracer-level attribution, not source availability.
Growth-index f-sigma8 is an approximation. CLASS/CAMB importability is insufficient without an explicit stable RLL perturbation contract and cross-backend residuals.
